stories.title: BT digital hub on Queensferry’s Station Road gets council approval
stories.summary: BT has been given the go-ahead to install a digital advertising hub on Queensferry’s Station Road, weeks after a similar plan was refused in Shotton. stories.title: Eta Aquarid meteor shower from Halley’s Comet peaks over Flintshire on Wednesday
stories.summary: A meteor shower made from the debris of Halley’s Comet will peak over Flintshire skies before dawn on Wednesday morning. stories.title: Coleg Cambria student named one of Wales’s top adult learners
